stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Near a river, a stone marker showed the height of a flood from long ago.”?
options: Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions.
It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.
The ancient recipe did not make the past fully return, but it helped visitors imagine ordinary people sitting down to a meal thousands of years before them.
The teacher explained that memory markers help communities remember risks after years of safety make people careless.

本文沒有陳述「It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The ancient recipe did not make the past fully return, but it helped visitors imagine ordinary people sitting…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The teacher explained that memory markers help communities remember risks after years of safety make people careless.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
